statement: Round two verified 9,865 sampled method/query counts, measured 216 fresh processes and added a fixed confirmation. Persisted suffix8 has modest observed gains with explicit startup/memory and timing-noise limits.
status: Open for pre-release contributor trials and expert-agent review; scientific acceptance pending.
scope: Computational exact literal substring counting on public reference sequences. No wet-lab or biological-effect work; no novelty or production-workload claim.
reproduce_full: python src/trial.py (in a copy; writes new results)

assumptions.statement: Independent external review and upstream-usefulness assessment remain open.
Confirmation improved repeatability but quiet-machine replication, real traces and a second competitive compressed index remain needed.
